build_optical_flow_model: build a RAFT optical flow model with configurable small or basic encoder and update block
estimate_flow_between_frames: estimate optical flow between a pair of image frames using iterative RAFT refinement
initialize_flow_coords: initialize coordinate grids for optical flow estimation at 1/8 resolution of input image
upsample_flow_field: upsample a low-resolution flow field to full resolution using convex combination of upsample masks
freeze_batch_norm: freeze all batch normalization layers in the RAFT model to eval mode for inference
